title: Fiserv Deep Dive Analysis
summary: Currency stress, crypto concentration and Fiserv.
coverage_note: All article text blocks were read. Ledger covers material macro, investment, and causal propositions; incidental descriptive statistics, boilerplate, and unreasoned position lists are excluded. Image labels were read, not image pixels.

claims.reason: The BoJ could purchase unlimited yen-denominated bonds, and later widened its band. That supports the operational distinction between defending a nominal yield and defending currency purchasing power. Complete control overlooks implementation constraints, and the December change cited market functioning rather than proving currency weakness was the sole trigger.

framework_lessons: Separate business resilience from valuation risk.
assessment: The imminent Terra warning and Ethereum concentration analysis are strong, independently supported contributions. The preferred Chinese bottom view failed, and Panama legislative status was overstated. Fiserv illustrates the need to preserve the entire investment path: strong initial growth and gains were followed by a major operating reset and stock reversal. Explicitly tentative bond and Bitcoin scenarios are not treated as confident failed predictions. The author also admits dollar and yield moves exceeded her earlier base case.
verification_limitations: Captured website text is not an authenticated publication-date version.
Chart-only numerical claims have not been visually verified.
Selected stock/ETF adjusted-close comparisons are disclosed where used; no reconstructed portfolio backtest has been performed.
Unresolved verdicts are not forecast failures or successes; no aggregate hit rate is inferred.
